question: Convert the highest reported PHA titre in the corpus from grams per litre to milligrams per millilitre.

claims.text: Highest PHA titre among the titre records in the corpus, from cyclic fed-batch Bacillus thuringiensis on glucose-rich hydrolyzate, converted from grams per litre to milligrams per millilitre by the platform's unit engine

gaps: A review in the corpus (P16) states a fed-batch PHB figure higher than this titre, but it is recorded only as PHA content in percent of cell dry weight (cl1-P16-1dc33273), so the unit engine cannot convert it to milligrams per millilitre. A titre record for that figure, with its primary source and conditions, would be needed before it could be compared or converted.

The corpus records of the highest titre (cl1-P22-e813ae43) are unverified curation notes, and its conditions field is empty, so the cultivation scale and strain details behind this value are not established.
The unit engine converted the value, but I could not write the converted number in this answer; the figure is shown from the evidence item beside the claim.
